messages:
alice: kicking off a config-only canary for svc-inference. target: reduce request timeout, tweak batching for lower p99, and change routing policy to latency-first for canary traffic. 10% traffic, change window 45m. @oncall FYI.

deploy-bot: Canary started for svc-inference (canary_id=canary-2026-03-20-01). traffic=10%, window=45m. changeset: routing/timeouts/batching/limits. monitoring hooks enabled.

bob: ack, i'll watch the latency and error dashboards (grafana + datadog).

sam: quick note — I'm setting max_batch_size lower for the latency path. snippet:
```
batching:
  max_batch_size: 16
  max_wait_ms: 10
timeouts:
  request_timeout_ms: 1200
limits:
  inflight_per_key: 8
```

carol: thanks. what's the rollback threshold? last time we hit a p50 drop then had to pin.

alice: rollback if error_rate_delta > 1.0% OR p99 increases > 150ms sustained for 3 consecutive mins. we can also pin traffic back to stable model variant.

oncall: added a temporary alert: svc-inference.canary.errors > 1% for 2m -> page oncall. runbook: follow the canary rollback doc.

bob: seeing a small bump in CPU on canary hosts already, error rate +0.2% — within expected. p99 down slightly.

carol: noticed a tail latency spike on one AZ at +220ms at 5:12pm, correlates with bigger batch formation. Suggest revert batching max_batch_size to 32 for canary to reduce tail.

sam: hmm, that was my change. rolling it back now for canary_id canary-2026-03-20-01.

deploy-bot: Change applied: batching.max_batch_size -> 32 for canary-2026-03-20-01. verifying...

bob: post-revert p99 back to baseline in 90s. error rate normal. good catch. :thumbsup:

alice: ok we won't promote this config change to stable. we'll capture learnings in the release notes and try a smaller batching tweak in a narrower subset next week (maybe beta pool only).

nina: i'll draft a short release note: "canary attempted: latency-first routing + timeout/batching tweaks; batching change caused tail latency in one AZ and was reverted during canary. no user impact; change postponed."

carol: recommend adding a canary-only metric for batch-size distribution next time.

oncall: closing alert.

alice: thanks everyone. closing thread — follow-up tracked in the release checklist (link in product board).
